Elephant Kills Elderly Man After Being Attracted by Alcohol Scent

An elephant, separated from its herd, entered a human settlement in India after being drawn by the smell of Mahua liquor. The animal reportedly attacked and killed an elderly man. The elephant also damaged a house wall before the incident.
